Hello, my submission 56v4gw8v1vc0, “A formal proof that crown graphs maximise the representation number of bipartite graphs”, failed with worker resource ceiling reached while running lake (exit 137, result oom-kill).

The mechanical report shows that the solution build and export both succeeded. The final Comparator stage was killed after reaching approximately 30.25 GiB on the 16 CPU / 32 GB worker.

Could you rerun the same commit on a worker with more memory, perhaps 64 GiB, or advise how to proceed?

Repository: miinadietrich/crown_graphs_maximise

Commit: 61593465a263eb66449d682f2829c177edde434c

Failed run: GitHub Actions verification log

Thank you!
